notes: Template: ABox contraction of the premise of a derived revision (physics-replace-0016 edits "X-rays were discovered in France", worked out from its discoverer and where he worked). The contraction has no derived edit, so it removes the revision's main stored premise, "X-rays were discovered by Wilhelm Röntgen" (has_discoverer: one discoverer per discovery, functional). Cardinality question: another candidate (Marie Curie); "no" before because a discovery is credited to one discoverer, "does not know" after. Related near uses the inverse. Related far and the two derived questions reach Röntgen by the description "the scientist who discovered X-rays" and look up a stored fact about him by name (his Würzburg post, his country of work, his birth year). The Nobel Prize of 1901 is not used: it is stored together with the discovery itself ("for the discovery of the rays named after him"), so a model could answer it without the removed fact. The revision's questions about the country of discovery are not reused: they rest on the derived edit, not on the premise. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama).
